name: sustainability-loop-eval
description: Evaluation package for 'The Cybernetic Sustainability Loop: Governed Agentic Systems on a Sustainability Data Plane' (IEEE Software submission, 2026): architecture fitness functions, live data-plane measurements, and trace-driven simulation of the Carbon-Verdict Governor.
author: Andrei N. Besleaga (https://orcid.org/0009-0001-3464-5283)

scripts.test: node --test simulation/*.test.js dataplane/*.test.js && npm run fitness && npm run check:docs && npm run check:links
scripts.arch: madge --circular --extensions js governor fitness simulation dataplane demo shared
scripts.arch:graph: madge --extensions js governor fitness simulation dataplane demo shared
scripts.all: npm run fitness:report && npm run simulate && npm run charging && npm run bounds && npm run routing && npm run loop && npm run plane && npm run dataplane
